en.bdb: Amar Das,the Grandson of Guru Nanak

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਪਰਚਾਇਕੈ ਚੇਲੇ ਤੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਤੇ ਚੇਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat parachaikai chele te gur gur te chelaa|

en.bdb: Absorbing consciousness in the Word, the disciple became Guru and the Guru disciple.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਾਣਾ ਤਾਣਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਸੂਤੁ ਇਕੁ ਹੁਇ ਕਪੜੁ ਮੇਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: vaanaa taanaa aakheeaai soot ik hui kapaR melaa|

en.bdb: Ward and weft are separate names but in the form of yam they are one and are known as the one, cloth.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਧਹੁ ਦਹੀ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਦਹੀਅਹੁ ਮਖਣੁ ਕਾਜੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: dhudhahu dhahee vakhaaneeaai dhaheeahu makhan kaaj suhelaa|

en.bdb: The same milk becomes curd and from curd is made butter to be used variously.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਿਸਰੀ ਖੰਡੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਜਾਣੁ ਕਮਾਦਹੁ ਰੇਲਾ ਪੇਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: misaree kha(n)dd vakhaaneeaai jaan kamaadhahu relaa pelaa|

en.bdb: From the sugar cane juice are prepared the lump sugar and other forms of sugar.

verses.gurmukhi: ਖੀਰਿ ਖੰਡੁ ਘਿਉ ਮੇਲਿ ਕਰਿ ਅਤਿ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਸਾਦ ਰਸ ਕੇਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: kheer kha(n)dd ghiau mel kar at visamaadh saadh ras kelaa|

en.bdb: Mixing the milk, sugar, ghee etc. many dainty dishes are prepared.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਨ ਸੁਪਾਰੀ ਕਥੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਚੂਨੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਸੁਰੰਗ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: paan supaaree kath mil choone ra(n)g sura(n)g suhelaa|

en.bdb: Likewise when betal, betel nut, catechu and lime are mixed, they produce a beautiful colour.
In the same way the grandson Guru Amar Das has been authentically established.
